description: This file contains function declarations related to operator version upgrading in the Torch JIT component. It defines structures and functions used for managing operator schema versions, checking if operators are up-to-date, loading historic operator schemas, and querying upgrader version ranges.

classes.name: UpgraderRange
classes.description: A simple struct representing a range of operator versions with minimum and maximum version numbers.

methods.name: findUpgrader
methods.description: Finds a valid upgrader entry for a given list of upgrader schemas and current version.

methods.name: isOpCurrentBasedOnUpgraderEntries
methods.description: Checks if an operator is up-to-date based on registered upgrader entries.

methods.name: isOpSymbolCurrent
methods.description: Checks if an operator symbol is current given its name and version.

methods.name: loadPossibleHistoricOps
methods.description: Loads possible historic schemas for an operator that might be deprecated or no longer exist.

methods.name: getMaxOperatorVersion
methods.description: Returns the highest version number available among all operators.

methods.name: getUpgradersRangeForOp
methods.description: Returns the version range supported by upgrader entries for a specific operator.
